_comment: Names and descriptions written from the sweep's frames (and the subtitles OCR'd out of them). The kind is NOT set here except where a frame cannot show it - that is measured by tools/classify_scene.py. Merged into scene_info.json by tools/apply_sweep.py.

s00a00l.name: Three Days Earlier at the cemetery
s00a00l.description: The game's opening framing scene, before Act 1. Old Snake, in a suit, salutes Big Boss's grave; Otacon comes to fetch him and Campbell briefs him in the helicopter on Liquid's whereabouts, leading into Liquid Sun.

s00a00l_D.name: The cemetery
s00a00l_D.description: Old Snake in a suit among the headstones on a grey morning. The epilogue's framing scene.

s00a10l.name: Snake at Big Boss's grave
s00a10l.description: The epilogue after Outer Haven. Snake lays flowers at the grave marked 'In memory of a patriot', smokes a last cigarette, then draws the Operator and puts it in his mouth. Ends on the white-out before Big Boss appears.

s00a10l_D.name: Walking to the grave
s00a10l_D.description: Snake crosses the cemetery to a headstone marked IN MEMORY OF A PATRIOT, and kneels.

s00a10l_D2.name: Big Boss appears
s00a10l_D2.description: Naked Sin. Snake could not pull the trigger; as he kneels in the cemetery Big Boss walks out of the light pushing Zero's wheelchair. Guns are drawn, then Big Boss disarms and embraces his son. Leads into the ink-wash history.

s00a10l_D3.name: How the Patriots were born
s00a10l_D3.description: Big Boss tells Snake where it all started: The Boss, Zero, himself, Ocelot, EVA, Para-Medic and Sigint, drawn as ink-wash sketches. Cuts back to the cemetery with Zero, then into the photographs of Zero's system.

s00a10l_D4.name: Big Boss on Zero's system
s00a10l_D4.description: Standing over Zero's wheelchair, Big Boss explains how Zero's fear of losing control grew into the AI network. Archival photographs and circuit lines illustrate it, then back to the cemetery and the ruined Zero.

s00a10l_D5.name: The war economy, then Zero
s00a10l_D5.description: The tail of Big Boss's account: the photo montage of the AIs' war economy, then back to the cemetery where Big Boss turns to the withered, hundred-year-old Zero. Leads straight into Zero's death.

s00a10l_D6.name: Zero's last breath
s00a10l_D6.description: Big Boss looks down at Zero, once his closest friend and the founder of the Patriots, and quietly ends him. He wheels the chair away and turns to Snake for his own farewell.

s00a10l_D7.name: The staff credits
s00a10l_D7.description: The end-credits roll after Big Boss's death, played in the game to 'Here's to You': motion-capture cast, production staff, programming, art, sound and Kojima Productions. Pre-rendered video, no 3D.

s00a10l_D9.name: Final Results
s00a10l_D9.description: The very end. Sunny's eggs cook in the pan, at last sunny side up, then the Final Results panel: play time, continues, alerts, kills, Drebin points and the emblem title you earned.

s01a00l.name: Ground Zero: first street, playable
s01a00l.description: The game's first playable moment, right where the opening hands over: Snake still under the militia cloak, crouched by the truck at Ground Zero with a stun knife and a ration, the PMC firefight ahead.

s01a00l_D.name: Liquid Sun opening: the war has changed
s01a00l_D.description: The start of the game: Kojima's credits over the sunlit ruins, Old Snake riding into the Middle East in the militia truck with a cigarette and the 'war has changed' monologue, then the PMC ambush. Hands over at Ground Zero.

s01a05l.name: Gekko stampede and the OctoCamo reveal
s01a05l.description: Second half of the opening: Gekko tear through the militia street, Snake sheds the cloak to show OctoCamo, is thrown through a building and hides among watermelons, then the Metal Gear Solid 4 title. Ends at a save prompt.

s01a05l_D.name: Snake in the alley
s01a05l_D.description: Snake pressed against a wall in the militia quarter, then close on him lighting a cigarette.

s01a10l.name: Liquid Sun act card and Otacon's call
s01a10l.description: Sunny frying eggs on Nomad and the Act 1: Liquid Sun card, then Snake at the Red Zone NW Sector wall taking Otacon's first Codec ('What's the situation?') before the Red Zone opens up to play.

s01a10l_1.name: Red Zone NW Sector, playable
s01a10l_1.description: Plain gameplay entry to the same spot the act card hands over to: Snake prone at the wall beside the Praying Mantis recruitment poster with an AK-102, the militia-held Red Zone ahead and the Mk. II still to find.

s01a10l_D1.name: Act 1: Liquid Sun
s01a10l_D1.description: The act title card, then the alley it opens onto.

s01a10l_D2.name: Snake meets the Mk. II and Otacon
s01a10l_D2.description: Inside the ruined building past the Red Zone checkpoint, Otacon's Metal Gear Mk. II catches up with Snake and hands over the Solid Eye, the Operator and the Mk. 2 tranquilizer pistol. Hands over to gameplay in the Red Zone.

s01a20l.name: Militia Safe House in the dark, playable
s01a20l.description: The pitch-black militia hideout between the Mk. II meeting and Drebin's warehouse. Snake starts inside with the Solid Eye's night vision as the only light and an AK-102, working toward the room where Drebin waits.

s01a20l_D.name: Meeting Drebin at the militia safe house
s01a20l_D.description: Snake creeps into the warehouse, finds Little Gray with a Narc can, and Drebin 893 steps out beside his EYE HAVE YOU Stryker: the ID-locked gun lecture, the laundering deal, the DP account. Leads to Otacon's war-economy call.

s01a30l.name: Urban Ruins: Otacon's war-economy call
s01a30l.description: Entry to the Urban Ruins just after Drebin, where Otacon's call comes in at once: 'Drebin does have a point' and the war economy that the whole game is about. Gameplay resumes in the militia quarter after the call.

s01a30l_1.name: Codec: Otacon on the war economy
s01a30l_1.description: The Codec itself, mid-patrol in the Urban Ruins: Otacon on 141.12 explaining the war economy and the 'war price' Drebin traded on ('What would happen if war just disappeared overnight?'). Same place as the stage entry.

s01a30l_2.name: Urban Ruins with the Drum Can, playable
s01a30l_2.description: Gameplay entry at the spot the oil-drum ambush scene hands over to: Snake prone by the crates in the Urban Ruins, the Drum Can just acquired, PMC patrols and the road toward Downtown and Advent Palace ahead.

s01a30l_D2.name: PMC ambush at the oil drums
s01a30l_D2.description: In the Urban Ruins after Drebin: from a doorway Snake watches a PMC soldier stalk a militia fighter around the rusted oil drums, then takes the battered Drum Can for himself. Hands over to gameplay with it in the inventory.

s01a40l.name: Advent Palace entry, playable
s01a40l.description: Playable entry into the Advent Palace hotel where Rat Patrol is holed up. Snake starts at an upper-floor doorway over the balconied atrium, before he opens the wrong door and runs into Meryl's team.

s01a40l_1.name: The balconied plaza
s01a40l_1.description: Playable: an open courtyard overlooked by balconies, PMC soldiers holding it.

s01a40l_2.name: Meryl's briefing and the FROG assault
s01a40l_2.description: Across the table of recon photos Meryl lays out Rat Patrol's PMC inspection job and what she knows of Liquid, Johnny gets caught out, then the Haven Troopers storm the hotel. Hands over to the Advent Palace firefight.

s01a40l_D2.name: Snake runs into Rat Patrol and Meryl
s01a40l_D2.description: Snake opens a door in Advent Palace and gets a gun in his face from Johnny; he takes him down, the rest of Rat Patrol Team 01 pile in, and Meryl recognises him. Ed, Jonathan and Johnny introduced; the table talk follows.

s01a40l_D3.name: Advent Palace garage: parting with Rat Patrol
s01a40l_D3.description: After the FROG fight the team regroups in the garage; Snake collapses from the strain, Meryl and he part ways with the mission still between them, and Otacon confirms Liquid's location to the north. Hands over to gameplay.

s01a50l.name: Advent Palace Garage, playable
s01a50l.description: Gameplay entry where the garage scene hands over: Snake prone in the Advent Palace Garage with the M4 Custom, Rat Patrol gone, heading out of the hotel and north toward Liquid's PMC camp.

s01a55l.name: Militia bulldozer charge and the Beasts' debut
s01a55l.description: Between Advent Palace and Millennium Park: the militia ram the PMC line with a bulldozer, Gekko wade in, and the Beauty and the Beast unit shows itself for the first time, wiping the street clean while Snake can only watch.

s01a55l_D.name: Militia firefight
s01a55l_D.description: Militia fighters shooting from cover, then Snake low behind a wall.

s01a57l.name: Millennium Park, playable
s01a57l.description: Playable after the militia charge is wiped out: Snake starts beside the burnt-out car at Millennium Park with the M4 Custom, making for the PMC camp where Liquid Ocelot is about to show himself.

s01a60l.name: Liquid Ocelot appears: the SOP crash
s01a60l.description: The act's climax at Millennium Park: Snake slips through the PMC camp for a shot at Liquid Ocelot, Meryl refuses to intervene over Codec (140.15), and Liquid's SOP test sends every soldier - and Snake - into convulsions.

s01a60l_D1.name: Under the Gekko
s01a60l_D1.description: A Gekko's legs against a blown-out sky, then the tarpaulined yard beneath.

s01a60l_D2.name: Liquid's SOP crash and the act's end
s01a60l_D2.description: Second half of the finale only, from Liquid on the balcony above the camp: the soldiers and Rat Patrol go down, Snake's seizing hand loses the shot, Liquid gloats with Vamp and Naomi looking on. Ends the act.

s02a10l.name: Act 2: Solid Sun
s02a10l.description: The act's opening entry: the Solid Sun title card, then Snake on the ground at Cove Valley Village, where Pieuvre Armement is putting down the local rebels. Everything in South America starts here.

s02a10l_1.name: Cove Valley Village, playable
s02a10l_1.description: Playable start on the edge of Cove Valley Village, by the lit buildings the PMC is holding. Snake's route to Naomi runs through the village toward Drebin's Stryker and the Power Station.

s02a10l_2.name: Cove Valley hillside, in the undergrowth
s02a10l_2.description: Another spawn in the same village map, starting on the wooded hillside above it with Snake in the undergrowth. Same objective: get through the PMC lines to the far side of Cove Valley Village.

s02a10l_3.name: Night ravine
s02a10l_3.description: Playable: a dark cut through the jungle.

s02a10l_D1.name: Act 2 opening: into the jungle
s02a10l_D1.description: The act's opening cutscene entry: Snake arrives in the South American jungle above Cove Valley Village, watching the PMC hunt the rebels, before the Rose call and the village itself.

s02a10l_D2.name: Codec: Campbell introduces Rosemary
s02a10l_D2.description: The mandatory 147.79 call early in Cove Valley Village: Campbell puts Snake on with Rose, now his counselor, to explain Psyche and stress before the act's fighting starts.

s02a20l.name: Codec: a voice from the past
s02a20l.description: Power Station start, Drebin having dropped Snake short of it. An unknown caller on 141.80 warns of government and PMC troops; Snake knows the voice. It is Raiden, not yet revealed.

s02a20l_1.name: Codec: 141.80, the jungle
s02a20l_1.description: A Codec call over the South American treeline.

s02a20l_10.name: Power Station, behind the boulder
s02a20l_10.description: Later playable start in the Power Station, Snake prone in the grass behind a boulder past the checkpoint, working through the PMC-held ground toward the Confinement Facility.

s02a20l_11.name: Boulder cover
s02a20l_11.description: Playable: Snake prone in grass behind a boulder.

s02a20l_2.name: Codec: 141.80, the jungle
s02a20l_2.description: A Codec call over the South American treeline.

s02a20l_3.name: Power Station: the ravine
s02a20l_3.description: Playable from checkpoint 1 of the Power Station, in the shadowed gully at its start. Drebin has just driven off; Raiden's first call comes in this area and the Confinement Facility lies beyond.

s02a20l_4.name: Power Station: the perimeter wall
s02a20l_4.description: Playable start on the dirt track beside the station's long brick wall, mid-way through the Power Station with PMC patrols ahead. Same map as the ravine entry, further along.

s02a20l_5.name: The brick wall track
s02a20l_5.description: Playable: a dirt track running beside a long brick wall.

s02a20l_6.name: Power Station: the wet rock face
s02a20l_6.description: Playable start on the road under the streaked rock face and fence line, a later section of the Power Station on the way out toward the Confinement Facility.

s02a20l_7.name: The waterfall face
s02a20l_7.description: Playable: a wet rock face streaked with falling water.

s02a20l_8.name: Power Station: the boulder field
s02a20l_8.description: Playable start in the open grassland broken by boulders inside the Power Station, one of several spawns in this map. Snake is crossing PMC ground to reach the Confinement Facility.

s02a20l_9.name: The boulder field
s02a20l_9.description: Playable: grassland broken by large boulders.

s02a25l.name: Drebin and Little Gray at the village
s02a25l.description: Snake reaches Drebin's Stryker past Cove Valley Village: Little Gray offers him a cigarette, Drebin and the apple, then the ride and Drebin's talk about SOP and the System before the drop-off at the Power Station.

s02a25l_D1.name: At the fence
s02a25l_D1.description: Snake behind a wire fence, then close on his face and the Solid Eye.

s02a25l_D2.name: At the fence
s02a25l_D2.description: Snake behind a wire fence, then close on his face and the Solid Eye.

s02a25l_D3.name: Drebin's SOP lecture: the schematic
s02a25l_D3.description: The pre-rendered nanomachine and Sons of the Patriots schematic from inside the Stryker, then the rest of Drebin's briefing: ACCESS DENIED on his terminal and Snake getting out before the Power Station.

s02a25l_D4.name: Snake leaves Drebin's Stryker
s02a25l_D4.description: The tail of the Stryker ride: Drebin and Little Gray see Snake off on the road and the truck drives on without him. Leads straight into the Power Station and Raiden's first call.

s02a30l.name: Confinement Facility, playable
s02a30l.description: Stage start for the Confinement Facility, the PMC prison compound between the Power Station and Vista Mansion. Snake begins on the jungle track between the rocks; Raiden reveals himself by Codec here.

s02a30l_1.name: Codec: Raiden on the dirt road
s02a30l_1.description: Entry on the forest road through the Confinement Facility with the 141.80 call landing at once: the voice from the Power Station admits who he is. Same call as the checkpoint entry, different spot.

s02a30l_10.name: Spotted at the boulder
s02a30l_10.description: Playable: behind a boulder with the alarm already up.

s02a30l_11.name: Confinement Facility: the rock face
s02a30l_11.description: Playable start at the foot of the rock wall facing the facility's watchtower and fence, a later section of the same map on the way to Vista Mansion.

s02a30l_12.name: The rock face
s02a30l_12.description: Playable: a steep rock wall above the track.

s02a30l_2.name: Confinement Facility: the dirt road
s02a30l_2.description: Playable start on the open dirt road through the trees, Snake crouched at the roadside. The same spot as the Raiden Codec entry, without the call.

s02a30l_3.name: Codec: "This is Jack, isn't it?"
s02a30l_3.description: The Raiden reveal on 141.80 at the start of the Confinement Facility: Snake asks if it is Jack; Raiden says Jack is no more and that he is close by. Fires over the jungle track at the checkpoint.

s02a30l_4.name: Jungle path
s02a30l_4.description: Playable: a narrow path under the canopy.

s02a30l_5.name: Codec: Raiden at the fence line
s02a30l_5.description: The same Raiden call taken from the ridge above the facility, at the timber fence with the hills beyond. A different spawn for the same conversation.

s02a30l_6.name: Confinement Facility: the ridge fence
s02a30l_6.description: Playable start on the ridge along the wooden fence above the compound, its buildings and towers below. Snake is skirting the PMC prison camp toward Vista Mansion.

s02a30l_7.name: Confinement Facility: facing the watchtowers
s02a30l_7.description: Playable start behind a boulder on the open ground under the pylons, the facility's watchtowers ahead. Another spawn in the same compound map.

s02a30l_8.name: The pylon field
s02a30l_8.description: Playable: open ground under a power pylon.

s02a30l_9.name: Confinement Facility: the gully
s02a30l_9.description: Playable start in the gully that drops to the fenced yard under a watchtower, a later section of the Confinement Facility past the ridge.

s02a40l.name: Vista Mansion, playable
s02a40l.description: Stage start for Vista Mansion, the estate the rebels are storming with a bulldozer against PMC defenders. Snake begins in the dry gully on the approach; the Research Lab and Naomi lie beyond it.

s02a40l_1.name: The dirt bank
s02a40l_1.description: Playable: a bare earth bank above the valley.

s02a40l_2.name: Vista Mansion: the ruined outbuilding
s02a40l_2.description: Playable start inside the roofless stone building on the mansion's approach, looking out over the grass to the fight. Same map as the gully entry, further in.

s02a40l_3.name: Vista Mansion: the rebel bulldozer
s02a40l_3.description: Playable start at the rebels' barricades beside the bulldozer they are pushing at the mansion's PMC line. Help the push or slip past; the lab is on the other side.

s02a50l.name: Into the lab: Naomi Hunter
s02a50l.description: Snake slips under the walkway and into the Research Lab to find Naomi at her desk, on the phone, the syringe on the table. Their first meeting since Shadow Moses, and the start of her briefing.

s02a50l_1.name: The lab, with Naomi's syringe
s02a50l_1.description: Playable inside the lab after Naomi's briefing, the syringe just acquired. Snake is alone in the building; Laughing Octopus's tentacles come through the ceiling seconds later.

s02a50l_2.name: Laughing Octopus in the research lab
s02a50l_2.description: The Act 2 boss: Snake is thrown to the floor and the fight with Laughing Octopus begins inside the lodge, her suit mimicking the rooms. Starts at the opening of the fight.

s02a50l_3.name: Laughing Beauty
s02a50l_3.description: Second phase of the boss: Octopus's shell is gone and the Beauty walks the lodge toward Snake. Her embrace ends the mission if she reaches him; the white-out ends her if he waits.

s02a50l_4.name: Outside the lab gate
s02a50l_4.description: Playable start among the boulders by the Research Lab's white gate, after Vista Mansion and before Snake goes inside to find Naomi.

s02a50l_D1.name: Into the rebel camp
s02a50l_D1.description: Snake under the walkway, then the camp beyond.

s02a50l_D2.name: Naomi's diagnosis: the medical readouts
s02a50l_D2.description: The pre-rendered scan of Snake's cells, DNA and the Patriots' founders, then Naomi in the lab explaining what is happening to his body. Hands back to gameplay after about three minutes.

s02a50l_D3.name: Naomi's results: FOXDIE and the aging
s02a50l_D3.description: Naomi copies Snake's data, hands him a cigarette and reads out the truth: accelerated aging, less than a year, and the FOXDIE in him about to mutate. Leads to the syringe and Octopus's entrance.

s02a50l_D5.name: Laughing Octopus arrives
s02a50l_D5.description: Snake moves through the lab alone after Naomi's briefing; the tentacles drop from the ceiling and Laughing Octopus makes her entrance. Hands over to the boss fight.

s02a50l_D6.name: Octopus unmasked: the Beauty emerges
s02a50l_D6.description: Laughing Octopus goes down, the suit falls away and Laughing Beauty steps out of it toward Snake. The bridge between the two phases of the boss fight.

s02a50l_D7.name: Laughing Beauty falls; Drebin's story
s02a50l_D7.description: The Beauty collapses among the petals and Snake picks up the FaceCamo from her shell. Drebin calls on 148.93 with the camo's use and Laughing Octopus's history: the Devil's Village and the Devil's Child.

s02a50l_D8.name: Laughing Beauty falls (white-out ending)
s02a50l_D8.description: The same aftermath reached the other way, out of the white void: the Beauty collapses, Snake takes the FaceCamo, and Drebin tells the Devil's Village story over the Codec.

s02a60l.name: Naomi's trail: Raiden's tracking lesson
s02a60l.description: Snake steps out of the lab to find Naomi gone and the gate open. He reads her tracks while Raiden coaches him on scouting and NV mode over 141.80, then the Mountain Trail tracking section begins.

s02a60l_1.name: Snake at the wall
s02a60l_1.description: Snake against the stonework, then close on his face.

s02a60l_2.name: Mountain Trail, playable
s02a60l_2.description: Playable start on the Mountain Trail among the rocks and thin trees, following Naomi's footprints from the lab toward the PMC helipad where Vamp is holding her.

s02a60l_3.name: Mountain Trail, in the tall grass
s02a60l_3.description: Later start on the same trail, Snake prone in the chest-high grass with the ridge beyond, still on Naomi's trail with PMC patrols between him and the helipad.

s02a70l.name: Vamp takes Naomi at the helipad
s02a70l.description: Snake reaches the PMC helipad as Vamp loads Naomi into the chopper; his headshot does not keep Vamp down. The Gekko close in, Drebin's Stryker crashes through, and Naomi drops onto its roof.

s02a70l_D.name: The watchtower
s02a70l_D.description: A figure under a great tree, then the rebel watchtower above the clearing.

s02a73l.name: Stryker escape: Vista Mansion
s02a73l.description: Playable on the roof gun of Drebin's Stryker as it runs back through Vista Mansion with Gekko and PMC troops after it. The first leg of the escape after the helipad.

s02a75l.name: Stryker escape: Confinement Facility
s02a75l.description: Second leg of the Stryker run, Snake on the turret as Drebin drives back through the Confinement Facility with Gekko bounding after them.

s02a78l.name: Stryker escape: Power Station
s02a78l.description: Third leg of the Stryker run through the Power Station, opening on the truck in the smoke and the turret before Snake takes the gun again.

s02a80l.name: Stryker escape: High Woodlands Highway
s02a80l.description: Last leg of the Stryker run, out of the tunnel onto the High Woodlands Highway with the hill town ahead, where the truck will give out and Raiden is waiting.

s02a85l.name: Raiden's entrance in the hill town
s02a85l.description: The Stryker wrecks in the town streets with Gekko behind it; Snake steadies Naomi, Drebin cracks a can, and then Raiden drops from the rooftops to cut the Gekko apart. His reveal, ending into the Marketplace.

s02a85l_D.name: The colonnade
s02a85l_D.description: An arcaded street in the hill town, sandbags stacked in the shade.

s02a90l.name: Marketplace, playable
s02a90l.description: Playable start in the Marketplace after Raiden's entrance: Snake on foot among the stalls, fighting through the PMC troops to get Naomi and Drebin's Stryker clear before Vamp arrives.

s02a95l.name: Raiden vs Vamp in the Marketplace
s02a95l.description: The act's climax: Vamp's chopper lands in the town and he faces Raiden blade to blade among the Gekko while Snake covers from the Stryker. Ends with Raiden holding the Gekko so the others can escape.

s02a95l_D.name: Naomi at the truck
s02a95l_D.description: Naomi in her white coat beside a vehicle, working at a panel.

s03a00l.name: Act 3: Third Sun
s03a00l.description: The act title card, then straight into the streets: Snake in his civilian disguise at the start of Midtown S Sector, before the resistance contact is picked out of the crowd.

s03a00l_D1.name: Act 3 opening: arrival in the city
s03a00l_D1.description: The act's opening cutscene. Snake, dressed as a local, arrives in the Eastern European city under martial law; Otacon sets up the job of finding the resistance contact and tailing him to Big Mama.

s03a10l.name: Midtown S Sector, playable
s03a10l.description: Start of the tail. Snake in the curfew-emptied streets of Midtown S Sector with PMC patrols about, waiting for the resistance member to lead him toward Big Mama. Opens on the item card.

s03a10l_1.name: Civilian Disguise acquired
s03a10l_1.description: Playable: the ITEM ACQUIRED card for the local's suit.

s03a10l_2.name: Midtown S Sector, by the van
s03a10l_2.description: Same sector as the main entry, different spawn: Snake beside a parked van further along the S Sector route, nothing equipped, mid-tail behind the resistance member.

s03a10l_3.name: The van in the alley
s03a10l_3.description: Playable: a parked van under a single lamp.

s03a10l_4.name: Midtown S Sector, the arched doorway
s03a10l_4.description: A third S Sector spawn, at the arched doorway near the sector's far end where the route turns toward Midtown Central. Still tailing the resistance member.

s03a10l_5.name: The van in the alley
s03a10l_5.description: Playable: a parked van under a single lamp.

s03a10l_6.name: The van in the alley
s03a10l_6.description: Playable: a parked van under a single lamp.

s03a15l.name: Midtown Central Sector, playable
s03a15l.description: Checkpoint into Midtown Central Sector, the second leg of the tail. This entry hands Snake a loaded XM8 and a stack of rations, so it plays looser than the story's stealth run.

s03a15l_1.name: Eastern Europe: Midtown Central Sector
s03a15l_1.description: Named by the game itself on the way in - CHECKPOINT >> EASTERN EUROPE, MIDTOWN CENTRAL SECTOR. Snake low in the rain-slick Prague streets under the lamps, the tail through Midtown behind the resistance man.

s03a15l_2.name: Midtown Central, the fountain courtyard
s03a15l_2.description: Another Central Sector spawn, in the courtyard with the fountain statue: the quiet side of the sector the resistance member passes while PMC patrols work the streets.

s03a15l_3.name: The lamplit street
s03a15l_3.description: Playable: a narrow street, lamps down one side.

s03a16l.name: Midtown NW Sector, playable
s03a16l.description: The tail moves into Midtown NW Sector, the darkest stretch of the city. Snake starts with the Stun Knife near a parked car, keeping his distance from the contact and the patrols.

s03a16l_1.name: Midtown NW, the unlit passage
s03a16l_1.description: A later NW Sector spawn, in the pitch-black passage under the iron railings. Same sector as the main NW entry, further along the resistance member's route.

s03a16l_2.name: The unlit passage
s03a16l_2.description: Playable: a passage with almost no light in it.

s03a20l.name: Midtown NE Sector, playable
s03a20l.description: The NE Sector detour, the gated street with the van. An XM8 loadout entry off the main tail route, good for a shootout with the patrols rather than the stealth run.

s03a20l_1.name: The gated street
s03a20l_1.description: Playable: iron railings and a van, the arch beyond lit.

s03a20l_2.name: Midtown NE, the alley lamp
s03a20l_2.description: Second NE Sector spawn, in the empty alley under a single lamp. Same sector as the gated-street entry, plain loadout.

s03a20l_3.name: The gated street
s03a20l_3.description: Playable: iron railings and a van, the arch beyond lit.

s03a25l.name: Midtown N Sector, playable
s03a25l.description: The last stretch of the tail. Snake in the narrow alleys of Midtown N Sector, close behind the resistance member as he heads for the church courtyard and Big Mama.

s03a25l_1.name: The dark arch
s03a25l_1.description: Playable: a black archway with the street beyond.

s03a25l_2.name: The dark arch
s03a25l_2.description: Playable: a black archway with the street beyond.

s03a30l.name: The church: Big Mama's ambush
s03a30l.description: The tail ends at the church. Snake follows the contact in, her men jump him, and the woman who stops the fight is EVA, now Big Mama of the Paradise Lost Army. Leads into her story.

s03a30l_D1.name: Following the resistance man
s03a30l_D1.description: Snake tails a man in a long coat down a Prague street.

s03a30l_D2.name: Big Mama's story: the Patriots
s03a30l_D2.description: In the church library Big Mama tells Snake how the Patriots began: Zero, Big Boss and the others who took up The Boss's will, and how Zero and Big Boss fell out. Told in the ink-sketch sequences.

s03a30l_D3.name: The Boss's legacy, in sketches
s03a30l_D3.description: The ink-sketch history straight through: Zero and Big Boss dividing over The Boss's will and the Patriots' founding, then back to the altar and on into the Les Enfants Terribles project.

s03a30l_D4.name: At the altar: Les Enfants Terribles
s03a30l_D4.description: At the candlelit altar Big Mama admits she was the surrogate mother of Snake and Liquid, and explains Les Enfants Terribles, Solidus, and why Liquid needs Big Boss's body: it is the key to the SOP System.

s03a30l_D5.name: Les Enfants Terribles, the sketch
s03a30l_D5.description: The illustrated part only: the cloning project, Solidus as Big Boss's substitute, the body kept alive by Zero, and the biometric key to the SOP System. Ends on the save prompt.

s03a30l_D6.name: Big Boss's picture, Zero's AIs
s03a30l_D6.description: Before the Virgin statue Big Mama shows Snake Big Boss as he was, then the story moves on to Zero's AI network that now runs the Patriots, and Liquid's plan to seize it with the body.

s03a30l_D7.name: The AIs, then out to the vans
s03a30l_D7.description: The last sketch sequence, Zero's AIs and the System, then Snake and Big Mama walk out to the resistance vans in the church courtyard where the body is waiting.

s03a30l_D8.name: Big Boss's body and the FROG ambush
s03a30l_D8.description: Snake sees the body under its plastic sheet in the van, then the Haven Troopers hit the courtyard. Big Mama's men are cut down and she and Snake shoot their way to her motorcycle. Leads into the chase.

s03a35l.name: Motorcycle chase: out of the church
s03a35l.description: The chase begins. Big Mama's Triumph tears out of the church courtyard behind the resistance vans with the Haven Troopers in pursuit; the opening cutscene, then Snake riding pillion with a gun.

s03a40l.name: Motorcycle chase: Riverside West
s03a40l.description: The playable riverside leg. Snake on the back of Big Mama's bike covering the resistance van, its health bar on the HUD, PMC vehicles and Haven Troopers closing along the river.

s03a50l.name: Chase cutscene: the Sliders on the bridge
s03a50l.description: Short cutscene between the two riverside legs: Raging Raven's Sliders swoop on Big Mama's bike and the resistance van as they cross the river bridge.

s03a50l_D.name: On the bike
s03a50l_D.description: Snake and Big Mama on the motorcycle, close, before the night street.

s03a60l.name: Motorcycle chase: Riverside East
s03a60l.description: The last playable leg of the chase. After the Sliders' attack on the bridge, Snake and Big Mama run the east bank with Raven's Sliders and Gekko on them, until the crash that ends the ride.

s03a65l.name: The crash, then Echo's Beacon
s03a65l.description: The bike goes down and Snake and Big Mama shelter under the arches; she is hurt worse than she lets on and sends him on alone. Snake enters Echo's Beacon and climbs until Raging Raven arrives.

s03a70l.name: Raging Raven's entrance
s03a70l.description: Inside Echo's Beacon Snake's body gives out on the stairs, the Sliders swarm the tower and Raging Raven makes her entrance. Leads straight into the boss fight.

s03a70l_1.name: Raging Raven on the tower
s03a70l_1.description: The boss fight, no intro. Snake in the tower of Echo's Beacon with the M4 against Raging Raven and her Sliders, her health bar already up.

s03a70l_2.name: Raging Beauty, the second phase
s03a70l_2.description: The fight's second half. Raven's suit is down and the Beauty comes for Snake with her grab; Snake with the Operator, her health bar up. A non-lethal win earns the FaceCamo.

s03a70l_D3.name: Raven falls, the Beauty emerges
s03a70l_D3.description: Between the two phases: the wing suit comes apart in a storm of feathers, the helmet drops, and Raging Beauty steps out and points at Snake. Leads into the Beauty fight.

s03a70l_D4.name: Raven's end, lethal: Drebin's story
s03a70l_D4.description: The lethal outcome. The Beauty burns out on the floor, Snake picks up the MGL-140, and Drebin calls with Raven's story: the caged children of Aceh and the flock that set her free.

s03a70l_D5.name: Raven's end, non-lethal: Drebin's story
s03a70l_D5.description: The non-lethal outcome. The Beauty collapses in her suit, Drebin calls with the same Aceh story plus 'you're something else, Snake', and the FaceCamo (Raging Beauty) is acquired.

s03a80l.name: Back to Big Mama after Raven
s03a80l.description: Snake returns from the tower to find Big Mama by the wrecked bike, hurt but moving. They head down to the river where the resistance is holding the body, with Liquid's men already watching them.

s03a90l.name: Liquid at the riverside
s03a90l.description: Snake and Big Mama reach the river tunnel to find Liquid Ocelot waiting with his Haven Troopers and Vamp, the resistance boat blown, and Big Boss's body in his hands. Ends inside the System's visualisation.

s03a90l_D2.name: Liquid takes the System
s03a90l_D2.description: From the System visual on: with Big Boss's biometrics Liquid seizes SOP. Every gun on the riverside dies, Snake's nanomachines go haywire and Liquid beats him down; Meryl's Rat Patrol arrives by boat.

s03a90l_D3.name: Guns of the Patriots
s03a90l_D3.description: Starts at the confrontation: Snake convulsing as the System turns on him, Liquid crowing over him, Big Mama's apple rolling on the stones, then Liquid's boat and the Rat Patrol's arrival on the river.

s03a90l_D4.name: Guns of the Patriots on the river
s03a90l_D4.description: Pre-rendered video. The chase ends at the river: Liquid, Big Boss's body secured, turns the System on everyone. Rat Patrol's guns lock, the Army's helicopters fall, Snake can't fire, Liquid sails away. Then the fire.

s03a90l_D5.name: Johnny saves Meryl, Big Mama dies
s03a90l_D5.description: Pre-rendered video. The aftermath of the fire: Johnny brings a stopped Meryl back with mouth-to-mouth while a burned Snake holds the dying Big Mama on the embankment. Act 3's last scene before the Nomad and Shadow Moses.

s04a05l.name: Metal Gear Solid (1998) dream
s04a05l.description: Act 4 opens with Snake dozing on the Nomad and dreaming the original MGS1 dock infiltration. This entry launches the bundled 1998 game as its own window (mgs1.exe), which must be closed separately; it is not an MGS4 scene.

s04a10l.name: The flight back to Shadow Moses
s04a10l.description: Act 4's opening cutscene. Snake wakes from the MGS1 dream in the helicopter cabin as Otacon flies him through the Alaskan storm toward Shadow Moses, where Liquid is after REX's railgun. Ends on the save prompt.

s04a10l_1.name: Landing in the snowfield
s04a10l_1.description: Start of Act 4 gameplay. Snake, dropped in a whiteout, gets up from the snow at the Snowfield checkpoint and heads for the old base, with Otacon's Mk. III tagging along. Nine years after MGS1, the island is a frozen ruin.

s04a10l_10.name: Out into the canyon
s04a10l_10.description: The Canyon checkpoint: Snake leaves the tank hangar's north door for the canyon where MGS1's M1 tank fight happened, a wrecked truck in the snow ahead. Leads down to the Nuclear Warhead Storage Building.

s04a10l_11.name: Canyon doorway
s04a10l_11.description: Snake crouched in the hangar-side doorway looking out over the canyon and the wrecked vehicle among the pines. Same canyon section as the checkpoint entry, without the banner; a slightly different spawn.

s04a10l_12.name: Canyon floor, crawling
s04a10l_12.description: Snake prone on the canyon floor against the rock wall, deeper along the ravine toward the warhead storage building. A later canyon spawn under the Gekko patrol, past the wrecked truck.

s04a10l_2.name: Snowfield pass
s04a10l_2.description: A later spawn on the snowfield, on the rocky path winding between the cliffs and pines toward the heliport. Same section as the landing entry, further along, with the Gekko and Dwarf Gekko patrols ahead.

s04a10l_3.name: First sight of the heliport
s04a10l_3.description: Snake on the snowfield ridge where the MGS1 heliport and hangar first come into view through the blizzard. Same section as the landing, near its end, just before dropping down to the helipad where it all began.

s04a10l_4.name: Heliport: by the trucks
s04a10l_4.description: Snake crouched beside the parked trucks on the snowed-under helipad, the spot where Liquid's Hind once sat. A mid-heliport spawn on the way to the tank hangar, past the searchlight cameras of MGS1.

s04a10l_5.name: Heliport: the upper walkway
s04a10l_5.description: Snake on the railed upper gantry overlooking the heliport, the route above the helipad that leads around to the hangar doors. A heliport spawn on the same run as the trucks entry, higher up.

s04a10l_6.name: Arriving at the heliport
s04a10l_6.description: The Heliport checkpoint itself: Snake steps out between the cliff walls onto the helipad with the trucks ahead, retracing MGS1's first steps. Leads on to the tank hangar and then the canyon.

s04a10l_7.name: Heliport: the icy trench
s04a10l_7.description: Snake in the frozen ventilation trench beside the heliport, the sunken duct run from MGS1 now hung with icicles. A side spawn of the heliport section, between the helipad and the hangar entrance.

s04a10l_8.name: Heliport: the concrete gallery
s04a10l_8.description: Snake in the snow-choked concrete passage with the steel grating that runs along the heliport's edge toward the hangar. Another heliport-side spawn, just before the Tank Hangar checkpoint.

s04a10l_9.name: Into the tank hangar
s04a10l_9.description: The Tank Hangar checkpoint: Snake passes between the door pillars into the derelict hangar where the abandoned tank still sits, Dwarf Gekko scuttling in the dark. The way through to the canyon.

s04a10l_D2.name: Act 4: Twin Suns title card
s04a10l_D2.description: The act's brush-lettered title, 'Act 4 Twin Suns', fading up from white. Sits between the helicopter arrival cutscene and Snake landing in the snowfield; no gameplay in this entry.

s04a20l.name: Warhead storage: the 1F loading bay
s04a20l.description: The Nuclear Warhead Storage Building 1F checkpoint: Snake crawls into the icy ground-floor loading bay from the canyon, snow blowing through the open doors. The way down to Otacon's old lab on B2.

s04a20l_2.name: Warhead storage: the B2 corridor
s04a20l_2.description: The Nuclear Warhead Storage Building B2 checkpoint: Snake in the basement corridor outside Otacon's old lab, past the cells where he once found Meryl. Leads to the lab and the Mk. III passcode cutscene.

s04a20l_3.name: Inside Otacon's old lab
s04a20l_3.description: A B2 spawn inside the darkened lab itself, among the terminals and cubicles where Snake first met Otacon in MGS1. Same section as the B2 corridor entry, further in, right before the passcode cutscene plays.

s04a20l_5.name: Warhead storage: the rack walkway
s04a20l_5.description: Snake on the raised walkway of the 1F storage hall, looking down on the empty warhead racks. A 1F spawn on the same floor as the loading bay entry, further inside, on the way to the basement stairs.

s04a20l_7.name: Warhead storage: the empty hall
s04a20l_7.description: An overhead spawn in the 1F storage hall where the warheads used to sit, stairways either side and Dwarf Gekko wreckage on the floor. Same 1F section as the loading bay entry, a different door.

s04a20l_D.name: Otacon's lab and the Mk. III
s04a20l_D.description: Snake reaches Otacon's old lab on B2 and the Mk. III plugs into his terminal while Otacon guides him from the Nomad. Snake has a FOXDIE spasm at the desk, then the game asks for the lab's security code on Otacon's screen.

s04a30l.name: Out onto the snowfield
s04a30l.description: The Snowfield & Communications Tower checkpoint: Snake leaves the warhead storage building for the open snowfield where Crying Wolf and her Haven Troopers are waiting. The start of the section, before her intro cutscene.

s04a30l_2.name: Crying Wolf in the snowfield
s04a30l_2.description: The Crying Wolf boss fight from its start: Snake behind the fallen tree by the trucks in the blizzard, her rail gun somewhere out in the whiteout and Haven Troopers hunting between the pines. Follows the intro cutscene.

s04a30l_3.name: Crying Beauty
s04a30l_3.description: The second phase of the Crying Wolf fight: the Beauty has climbed out of the wrecked wolf shell and walks Snake down in the snow. Starts with the Operator drawn, right after her transformation cutscene.

s04a30l_D1.name: Crying Wolf's intro
s04a30l_D1.description: Snake crosses the snowfield, a white wolf shadows him, and Crying Wolf pounces from the drifts, her rail gun and Haven Troopers closing in. Hands over to the sniper duel in the blizzard as soon as the intro ends.

s04a30l_D2.name: The Beauty climbs out of the Wolf
s04a30l_D2.description: Crying Wolf's shell collapses and the Beauty crawls out, weeping and clutching at her head while Snake watches, then stalks toward him. Hands over to the Crying Beauty fight with the Operator, and her grab if she reaches him.

s04a30l_D4.name: Crying Beauty's end and the rail gun
s04a30l_D4.description: One ending of the Beauty fight: she reaches for the sky in the white light and falls. Snake retrieves her rail gun, and Drebin calls with Wolf's story of the refugee camp. Ends on the Rail Gun acquired card.

s04a30l_D5.name: Crying Beauty falls, the rail gun
s04a30l_D5.description: The other ending of the Beauty fight: she drops in the snow beside the Wolf shell. From there it plays the same as D4: Snake picks up the rail gun and Drebin tells Wolf's story, 'three down, one to go'.

s04a30l_D6.name: The wolf carries her away
s04a30l_D6.description: After the fight the white wolf noses at Crying Wolf's body and carries it off into the snow while Snake watches; the Mk. III scouts ahead. Hands over to gameplay at the door toward the Communications Tower.

s04a30l_D7.name: FaceCamo (Crying Beauty) acquired
s04a30l_D7.description: The item-acquired card for the Crying Beauty FaceCamo, the reward for beating the Beauty non-lethally. Just the popup; the sweep's game exited straight after it.

s04a50l.name: Underground Base: the way to REX
s04a50l.description: The Underground Base checkpoint: Snake crouched in the dark concrete passage under Shadow Moses, past the blast furnace, on his way to the hangar where REX still stands. Leads into the REX hangar cutscene with Vamp and Naomi.

s04a50l_D.name: The REX hangar: Vamp and Naomi return
s04a50l_D.description: Snake climbs down into the old hangar and finds REX rusting where he left it. Vamp appears on the catwalk with Naomi, who has the suppressor for his nanomachines. Hands over to the Vamp fight on REX's back.

s04a60l.name: Vamp on REX's back
s04a60l.description: The Vamp boss fight from its opening: Snake faces Vamp atop REX in the hangar, the Underground Supply Tunnel checkpoint on screen. Knock him down and use the syringe to shut off his nanomachines; Raiden's arrival follows.

s04a60l_2.name: Suicide Gekko while Raiden fights Vamp
s04a60l_2.description: The split-screen section after Vamp falls: Snake, rail gun in hand, holds the hangar against the Suicide Gekko while the other half of the screen shows Raiden duelling Vamp. Ends with REX's activation and Naomi's goodbye.

s04a60l_D1.name: Vamp arrives with Naomi
s04a60l_D1.description: The second half of the REX hangar arrival: Snake at REX's wreck, Vamp on the gantry above with Naomi at his side, spreading his arms to be shot. Hands over to the Vamp fight; a later start on the Underground Base cutscene.

s04a60l_D2.name: Raiden vs Vamp on REX
s04a60l_D2.description: Snake puts the syringe into the downed Vamp, then Raiden drops in and takes Vamp on, blade to knife across REX's chest, as the Suicide Gekko stream in. Hands over to the split-screen Gekko fight with the rail gun.

s04a60l_D3.name: Vamp's death and Naomi's goodbye
s04a60l_D3.description: After the Gekko: Naomi finishes Vamp with the suppressor, tends the broken Raiden, and tells Snake and Otacon the truth about her cancer and nanomachines, syringe in hand. Leads to REX's activation and the escape.

s04a65l.name: REX in the Surface Tunnel
s04a65l.description: Snake pilots REX up the Surface Tunnel with the base's self-destruct clock running and Suicide Gekko in the way. The Surface Tunnel checkpoint, straight into REX's cockpit with the gatling gun; leads out to the port and RAY.

s04a68l.name: REX vs RAY: Liquid arrives
s04a68l.description: REX bursts out of the tunnel into the port as the base blows, and Liquid's RAY leaps down to meet it; Liquid gloats from RAY's cockpit. Hands over to the REX vs RAY boss fight at the harbour, gatling gun and missiles.

s04a70l.name: REX vs RAY at the port
s04a70l.description: The REX vs RAY boss fight from the Port Area checkpoint, both Metal Gears' bars up and RAY circling on the docks. Same fight as the intro cutscene entry, without the cutscene; win it and Outer Haven rises.

s04a75l.name: Old Snake in the rain
s04a75l.description: Act 4's ending, from RAY's fall: Liquid climbs out of the wreck, Outer Haven surfaces and takes REX's railgun, and Raiden holds the ship off Snake with his own body until it backs away. Snake is left broken on the pier.

s04a75l_D2.name: Outer Haven and Raiden's arm
s04a75l_D2.description: The back half of the harbour ending: Liquid walks off, Outer Haven surfaces with the railgun, and Raiden is crushed against the pier holding it back, losing his arm. Same scene as the full ending entry, later start.

s04a75l_D3.name: Liquid sails, the chopper comes
s04a75l_D3.description: The act's last scene: Liquid on Outer Haven's deck as the Missouri closes in and Haven dives; Snake lies bleeding on the pier until Otacon's helicopter finds him. Ends on the Act 4 results screen.

s05a10l.name: Ship bow: sneaking onto Outer Haven
s05a10l.description: Act 5 gameplay begins. Snake has landed on Outer Haven's bow after the Nomad catapult and must slip past the Haven Troopers on deck to get inside the ship. Starts crawling among the containers below the superstructure.

s05a10l_D.name: Snake lands on Outer Haven's deck
s05a10l_D.description: The act's opening after the Nomad briefing: Snake comes to on the deck, coughs through his failing body, sizes up the superstructure as Haven Troopers patrol above, and the Mk. III joins him. Leads into the ship-bow gameplay.

s05a20l.name: Into the ship's corridors
s05a20l.description: Snake is inside Outer Haven, in the dim corridors between the deck and the command center where Screaming Mantis waits. Playable stage entry with the stun knife drawn, before the command center cutscene.

s05a20l_11.name: Missile hangar catwalk, playable
s05a20l_11.description: After leaving Meryl to hold the corridor, Snake runs the long lattice catwalk of the missile hangar toward the microwave corridor and GW. Playable, alone on the catwalk; s05a20l_12 is the same run with Haven Troopers behind.

s05a20l_12.name: Haven Troopers chase through the missile hangar
s05a20l_12.description: Same missile hangar catwalk as s05a20l_11, but the entry starts at the door with a squad of Haven Troopers pouring in behind Snake. He has to outrun them down the hangar while Meryl covers the corridor he just left.

s05a20l_2.name: Command center, playable
s05a20l_2.description: Snake in the Outer Haven command center just after arriving, a Haven Trooper down beside the central pillar and Screaming Mantis not yet revealed. Same room as s05a20l_D1 but starts in gameplay after a brief demo.

s05a20l_5.name: Screaming Mantis puppets Meryl
s05a20l_5.description: Mid-fight with Screaming Mantis: her strings have Meryl on the floor turning her own gun on herself, so Snake must break the hold with the syringe while dodging Mantis. Includes her Psycho Mantis-style screen tricks.

s05a20l_6.name: Screaming Beauty phase
s05a20l_6.description: Second half of the command center fight. With the suit beaten, Screaming Beauty steps out and comes for Snake; the entry starts with her grabbing him and forcing him to the deck. Beating her leads into Psycho Mantis's return.

s05a20l_D1.name: Snake reaches the command center
s05a20l_D1.description: Snake enters the command center under the GW globe and finds Haven Troopers already dead on the floor. One jerks back to life on Screaming Mantis's strings and lunges at him, and the fight begins. Hands over to gameplay.

s05a20l_D10.name: Psycho Mantis returns, and Drebin's story
s05a20l_D10.description: After the Beauty falls, Psycho Mantis's spirit takes over the empty Mantis rig and rages until Snake reaches for the doll and the suit tears itself apart. Ends in a long Drebin codec on Mantis's childhood in a torture cellar.

s05a20l_D11.name: Meryl freed, then she holds the corridor
s05a20l_D11.description: Meryl wakes from Mantis's control as Haven Troopers storm the command center; she and Snake fight them off together, then retreat. At the corridor door Meryl stays to hold the line and Snake runs on to the missile hangar.

s05a20l_D12.name: Meryl and Johnny hold the corridor
s05a20l_D12.description: Snake has run for the missile hangar; Meryl and Johnny are left holding the corridor door against the Haven Troopers. Wounded and low on ammo, Johnny finally proposes, Meryl accepts with a kiss, and they fight on back to back.

s05a20l_D2.name: Screaming Mantis takes Meryl and Johnny
s05a20l_D2.description: The command center boss intro. Snake finds Meryl on the floor, her own gun turning on her head, and Johnny walks in and drops too: Screaming Mantis descends from the GW globe and shows herself. Hands over to the Mantis fight.

s05a20l_D5.name: Screaming Beauty steps out
s05a20l_D5.description: Halfway through the command center fight. The Mantis suit is beaten and spun apart, and the wailing Beauty peels out of it, dancing and lunging at Snake. Hands over to the Beauty phase of the fight.

s05a20l_D8.name: The Beauty falls, Psycho Mantis returns
s05a20l_D8.description: Screaming Beauty collapses in the white light and Snake reaches for the empty Mantis rig, only for Psycho Mantis's ghost to seize it. Runs on into Drebin's codec on Mantis's childhood. s05a20l_D9 is the other version.

s05a20l_D9.name: The Beauty falls in the command center
s05a20l_D9.description: Other version of the Beauty's defeat: she dies on the command center floor, Snake sheathes his knife, and Psycho Mantis's ghost takes the discarded rig before the suit tears itself apart. Runs on into Drebin's codec.

s05a30l.name: Raiden's stand: 'I'm no hero'
s05a30l.description: Past the missile hangar Snake's body gives out as Haven Troopers close in, and Raiden, arms gone and sword in his teeth, cuts through them. He refuses to be sent away and holds the door while Snake goes on to the microwave corridor.

s05a40l.name: GW: Otacon's Mk. III and the FOXALIVE
s05a40l.description: Pre-rendered end of the microwave corridor. Snake crawls burned into the lily-filled GW server room, the Mk. III jacks in and Otacon uploads FOXALIVE as the servers die, then Dwarf Gekko swarm him; Raiden and Meryl intercut.

s05a45l.name: Liquid's last words before the fight
s05a45l.description: Same deck lead-in as s05a45l_D, starting at Liquid's monologue over the photo collage of Big Boss and the Patriots, then the dusk deck where he calls Snake to his feet. Hands over to the Liquid Ocelot fist fight.

s05a45l_D.name: Liquid hauls Snake onto the deck
s05a45l_D.description: FOXALIVE has killed GW and the Patriots' AIs. Otacon reels at what they have done while Snake comes to on the top deck at dusk with Liquid Ocelot over him. Liquid's last speech leads into the fist fight; hands over to gameplay.

s05a50l.name: Liquid vs Snake on Outer Haven's deck
s05a50l.description: The final fist fight, entered straight into gameplay on the sunset deck with the OLD SNAKE and LIQUID bars up and Encounter playing. It runs through its MGS1, MGS2 and MGS3 phases to Ocelot's last words. Same fight as s05a50l_D.

s05a50l_D.name: The deck fight as Liquid staged it
s05a50l_D.description: The fist fight's cutscene run: Liquid stands over Snake at dusk, drags him up and sheds his coat, then the fight plays through its phase changes, the syringe in Snake's neck and the blows that leave Ocelot kneeling. Leads into s05a55l.

s05a55l.name: Ocelot's last words and the harbour
s05a55l.description: The act's ending. Ocelot falls on the deck, tells Snake he is pretty good, and dies as Snake kneels beside him. Boats and a helicopter come out from the Missouri, Otacon collects Snake, and the save prompt leads to the epilogue.

s10a10l.name: Start from the title screen
s10a10l.description: Boots the game the way it starts itself: the Kojima Productions logo, then the title screen over the cemetery with PRESS ANY BUTTON, and on to the main menu. Not a scene, just the normal front door.

s10a20l.name: Mission Briefing before Act 2
s10a20l.description: The Nomad after Liquid Sun. Snake has collapsed after his fit in the Middle East; Otacon and Sunny look after him, and Naomi's message from South America sets up Solid Sun. Starts on the cutscenes, then the interactive Nomad.

s10a20l_D2.name: Act 2 briefing, interactive part
s10a20l_D2.description: The Act 2 Mission Briefing joined at its interactive half: Snake is already up, Sunny brings the eggs and Otacon plays Naomi's message at his computer. Skips the opening cutscene; roam the Nomad before Solid Sun.

s10a30l.name: Mission Briefing before Act 3
s10a30l.description: The Nomad after Solid Sun, with Naomi aboard. She joins Sunny at the stove, pins a blue flower in her hair under Olga's photo, and the eggs finally come out right. Cutscenes first, then the interactive Nomad before Third Sun.

s10a30l_D2.name: Act 3 briefing, from Naomi and Sunny
s10a30l_D2.description: The Act 3 Mission Briefing without its egg-frying opener: begins with Sunny at the stove as Naomi joins her, through the flower and Olga's photo to the Nomad in flight, then hands over to the interactive part before Third Sun.

s10a40l.name: Mission Briefing before Act 4
s10a40l.description: The Nomad after Third Sun, Naomi gone with Liquid. Sunny cooks alone with the flower Naomi left her, then the Mk. II's last footage of Naomi among Liquid's people points to Shadow Moses. Cutscenes first, then the interactive Nomad.

s10a40l_D.name: Act 4 briefing, Sunny and the flower
s10a40l_D.description: The Act 4 Mission Briefing without its egg-frying opener: Sunny alone at the stove with Naomi's flower, the Mk. II's recovered footage, and Otacon unveiling the Mk. III, then the interactive Nomad before Twin Suns.

s20a00l.name: Mission Briefing before Act 5
s20a00l.description: After Shadow Moses, aboard the Missouri. Mei Ling briefs the team from a projector on the run at Outer Haven: Snake on oxygen, Meryl and Rat Patrol, Otacon with the Mk. III. Cutscene and interactive parts trade off before Old Sun.

s20a00l_D2.name: Snake and Otacon, a last cigarette
s20a00l_D2.description: The end of the Act 5 briefing. Snake smokes under a No Smoking sign in the Missouri's storeroom; Otacon comes in with the Mk. III, still grieving Naomi, and they settle how the assault on Outer Haven will go. Ends on the save prompt.

s20a00l_D3.name: Act 5 opens: Old Sun
s20a00l_D3.description: The Act 5 title card, then the Missouri under way: Mei Ling on the bridge with her crew, Snake, Otacon, Meryl and Rat Patrol on deck, and Drebin perched on a gun barrel offering Snake a drink before the run at Outer Haven.

s30a00l.name: Meryl and Johnny's wedding
s30a00l.description: The Epilogue title, Naked Sin, then the wedding on the airstrip by the Nomad: Meryl in her dress with Mei Ling, Campbell arriving to make peace with his daughter, Johnny at the altar, and Drebin's Stryker rolling up at the vows.

s30a00l_D2.name: Raiden, Rose and their son
s30a00l_D2.description: Raiden wakes in a hospital bed in his new body. Rose visits with flowers and brings little John; she tells him the miscarriage and her marriage to Campbell were a cover to shield them from the Patriots, and he meets his son.

s30a00l_D3.name: Drebin tells his story
s30a00l_D3.description: After the wedding. Drebin and Otacon sit by the Stryker with a bottle while Drebin admits he was raised a child soldier and worked for the Patriots, now that they are gone; Little Gray and the dancing wedding party around them.

s00a10l_D8.name: The title logo, and nothing more
s00a10l_D8.description: A stub of the ending: the game boots to the Metal Gear Solid 4 logo and stays there. No scene follows; the credits and Final Results are their own entries.
